description: The system never crashes or hangs due to resource exhaustion — all limits result in graceful degradation
property: For any resource exhaustion scenario, the system SHALL apply graceful degradation (queuing, model downgrade, or timeout) rather than process termination

invariants.description: When memory limit is approached, backpressure is applied instead of OOM
When VRAM is exhausted, new loads are blocked and eviction is attempted
When thermal state is critical, workloads are paused rather than crashing
All operations have finite timeouts — no operation can hang indefinitely
After adaptation is applied, system recovers when condition clears
